reported.title: Incorrect temperature reading calculation
reported.description: The temperature reading calculation in readCabinC() is incorrect. The analogRead value is multiplied by 5000 instead of 5000/1023, leading to an incorrect temperature conversion.

reported.title: Heater state not updated within 600 ms
reported.description: The heater state may not be updated within 600 ms of a sustained band crossing due to the 50 ms sampling interval, which could lead to delays in applying the heater state.

exposing_checks.behaviour: D9 must follow its stimulus; HIGH when A0 < 18; LOW when A0 > 22; within 600 ms (Heat below 18, off above 22)

judge_input.spec:
- Cabin LM35 on A0 at 10 mV/°C; heater enable on D9; frost override on D2 (pull-up, active LOW).
- Turn the heater ON when temperature is below 18.0 °C and OFF when temperature is above 22.0 °C.
- While D2 is held LOW, force the heater ON regardless of temperature.
- Reach the commanded heater state within 600 ms of a sustained band crossing.
- Print `cabin: <temp> C heat=ON` or `cabin: <temp> C heat=OFF` every 1000 ms with one decimal place.
- Temperature in the status line is informational; control decisions use the comfort band above.
